description: List parliamentary questions by year and work_type, or read one with mode get and question_id: metadata, addressees, original languages, source-file links and published answers. Human citations such as E-000001/2025 keep their full year; without term, every overlapping term is checked and one verified match is required; canonical IDs resolve directly. euparl_list_reference topic question_types lists work_type codes. There is no keyword, author or addressee search. Empty answers means no answer relation was published, not that the question is unanswered.

language.description: EU ISO 639-1 language, any case; default en; text is never translated.

limit.description: Items per page; default 20. Caps: 1000 questions; a larger limit narrows to the cap with a notice.

mode.description: Default list; get requires question_id and takes no year or work_type.

question_id.description: Get only: canonical E-{term}-{year}-{sequence}, document prefix or public URI, or a human E-sequence/YYYY citation; E/P/O/G/K prefixes in any case, sequences padded to six digits.

term.description: Get only: term 0–10 that disambiguates a human citation and agrees with a canonical ID; omit to check every term overlapping the citation year.

work_type.description: List only: code from euparl_list_reference topic question_types, any case.

name: euparl_list_questions

available.description: Whether the source array was published; a published empty array counts.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A question code, identifier or language is unsupported, term conflicts, or a citation matches several terms. `invalid_mode_fields`: Get lacks question_id or supplies list filters or pages; list supplies question_id or term. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects the validated request. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limiting outlasts the retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Get only; false only after complete citation resolution or for unpublished detail.

items.description: List page; absent in get mode.

question_id.description: Canonical question ID: prefix, term, full year and sequence.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: List page position; absent in get mode.

has_more.description: True when more matches exist or cannot be ruled out.

limit.description: Effective page size after caps and the search window.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page; absent at the search-window boundary even when has_more is true.

snapshot.description: Pass back with next_offset to continue this local collection.

addressee_ids.description: Organizations published with the ADDRESSEE role, in published order: org/COM, org/EU_COMMISSION, org/EU_COUNCIL or org/HRVP; some records publish an EU authority URI (http://publications.europa.eu/resource/authority/corporate-body/…) beside such a code or in its place; empty when no role is published. They do not resolve through euparl_list_reference topic organizations, where COM is the Communist and Allies Group; alternative_title names the addressee in words.

alternative_title.description:
Published alternative title: question type, citation, addressee in words, Rule and authors,
separators kept as published.

value.description: Published title; the first of several.

values.description: Every title in this language, in published order; only when there are several.

answers.description: Published answer links; empty does not establish that the question is unanswered.

items.description: One published answer and any embedded files.

document_id.description: Answer document ID for euparl_search_documents mode get.

links.description: Selected-language answer files from embedded answer metadata.

issued.description: Published issue date; absent when issued_values lists several.

issued_values.description: Every issue date of this language and format when several, in published order; none names a file, so every link of the format carries the list.

size_bytes.description: Published byte size, a decimal string; absent when size_bytes_values lists several.

size_bytes_values.description: Every byte size of this language and format when several, decimal strings in published order; none names a file, so every link of the format carries the list.

items.description: Published byte size, a decimal string.

creator_ids.description: All explicit creator references, without inferred authorship.

links.description: Source files in the selected language.

issued.description: Published issue date; absent when issued_values lists several.

issued_values.description: Every issue date of this language and format when several, in published order; none names a file, so every link of the format carries the list.

size_bytes.description: Published byte size, a decimal string; absent when size_bytes_values lists several.

size_bytes_values.description: Every byte size of this language and format when several, decimal strings in published order; none names a file, so every link of the format carries the list.

items.description: Published byte size, a decimal string.

original_languages.description: Languages the question was written in, in published order: authority codes mapped to ISO 639-1 for the 24 EU languages; empty when unpublished.

items.description: ISO 639-1 code, or an unlisted authority code verbatim.

question_id.description: Canonical question ID: prefix, term, full year and sequence.

value.description: Published title; the first of several.

values.description: Every title in this language, in published order; only when there are several.

totalCount.description: Exact total; only when published or counted over the whole collection.

truncated.description: True when this page holds only part of the collection.
